textContent.text: It was time for Rose the Bear's long rest. She just had to find a cave.

content.text: The Great Outdoors

textContent.text: Jade was the guide for a five-mile hike.
"This looks like a good place to set up camp," said Jade.
"Oh good," said Steve. "I'm tired!"
Steve and Jade set up their tents in the shade. Then, Jade made a fire. She poked it with a stick, and the flame lit up. Jade and Steve ate while the flame blazed.
Just then, a little snake poked out of a hole.
"Can I sit by the fire with you?" the snake asked.
Jade smiled. "I love snakes! Come sit with us. We have spice cake!"
Jade, Steve, and the snake sat by the fire eating cake.
